verdict.rationale: Interpreting shared images is a fair question for a text-based personal assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence never says Instinct accepts or analyzes screenshots or photos. The docs' mention of connecting to your 'screen' is a different capability (device access), not interpretation of images you send it. The community mention of screenshots concerns users sharing Terms of Service images with each other and is off-topic.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them
